data_fields.name: floor_row
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 (stop searching when a block sits at row 0)

best_idea: Pack a fixed set of decal and icon sprites offline into 1024 px pages with a lowest-then-leftmost skyline, so a whole fight's decal pass binds one texture per page instead of one per decal.
decision_why: Blood decals expire and this allocator cannot free one rectangle, so the skyline is for offline fixed sheets only; expiring decals need a runtime slot pool. GPL-3.0-or-later, so rewrite from the idea only.
acceptance: In a world fight and a Pit fight with 40 live blood decals, the decal pass issues at most 2 texture binds (one per 1024 px page); a unit test packs 64 sprites of 16-64 px into one page with no overlap and passes the four donor test cases.
